title: Zucchini Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Rinse the chicken, remove excess fat, and pat dry.
Shred the unpeeled zucchini in a food processor or grate on the large holes of a hand grater.
In a 1½-quart saucepan, melt the margarine and add the zucchini. Cook, stirring, for about 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Grate or shred the bread into crumbs and add to the zucchini.
Stir in the egg and seasonings, mixing well.
Carefully loosen the skin on each chicken quarter to form a pocket and spoon ¼ of the stuffing into each.
Brush each quarter with honey and bake for 50 minutes, until tender.
notes: USE: 10-inch skillet; ½-quart saucepan; roasting pan
